title: Assassin of Bhaal Cowl
summary: Gain +2 Initiative and Darkvision. Cast See Invisibility once per Short Rest.

fields.Effect: +2 Initiative. The tooltip lists 10 ft Darkvision, but the pinned passive source reports an effective range of 5 m (about 16 ft), including the character’s built-in detection range.
fields.Base value: 450 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.See Invisibility: Action once per Short Rest, on yourself until Long Rest. Detect invisible creatures or objects within 30 ft while not Incapacitated. Creatures in range that fail a Dexterity save against your spell save DC lose Invisibility.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
